title: New study or Edit study
purpose: Record a study or change its recorded approval, consent basis and status.

items.label: Code
items.description: Required. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', stored in capitals, unique. Fixed once the study has consent forms, collections or consents (shown read-only with that reason).

items.label: Status
items.description: Active, Suspended or Closed. Suspending or closing blocks distribution of the study's material; allocations already picked stay, and the gate blocks packing and dispatch.

items.label: Description
items.description: Optional. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Ethics reference, Ethics approved until
items.description: Optional. The date is shown on the study and never enforced.

items.label: Determination reference
items.description: Required for a study-level determination: the committee's letter or reference.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only; required and kept in the history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

After saving you are taken to the study. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
The study records what its ethics approval says; the software does not judge it.
